Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

There is a deterministic scientific validation writer in laws/.jvm test scope with clean-source, committed-oracle and atomic-output checks, plus drift/tamper tests. That generator produces the general scientific artifact; the requested EyeLink-specific release artifact binding support matrix, converter/oracle identities, differential/mutation/performance evidence and unsupported cells is not yet supplied by that general writer. Packaged portable ASC conformance is explicitly uncertified for EDF.

Evidence:
- laws/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/GenerateScientificValidationArtifact.scala:58
- laws/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/GenerateScientificValidationArtifactSuite.scala:1
- io/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/io/EyeLinkConformanceArtifactJvmSuite.scala:30

Remaining / next action: Reuse the existing fail-closed/atomic generator machinery for a separately versioned EyeLink artifact; add support-matrix/provenance/evidence inputs, development-vs-release policy and stale/tampered-input tests. Generator-only acceptance does not require unavailable vendor data or establish vendor conformance.

Disposition: Keep open.
